lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four horizontal rows, most prominent in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a lattice where spots are positioned at the nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a bright upper edge and a darker shadow gradient below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance spots are visible within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered in the anterior and medial sections.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral surface.
